methodology.distinct_exposures: Momentum, value, quality and low-volatility are distinct economic exposures, not assumed statistically independent. Value/quality implementation is delegated to the actual funds, not synthesized from current fundamental ratios.
methodology.sleeve_weights: Equal factor shares or bounded inverse trailing63-session volatility. All four factors have15%-35% of the intended equity sleeve before defense. No factor winner selection or fit to future returns.
methodology.risk_breadth: If enabled, multiply the entire equity sleeve by the fraction of12 factor/horizon observations whose63/126/252-session returns exceed BIL. A common scale preserves factor proportions; zero means no equity exposure. Freed budget goes to actual BIL.
methodology.defense: Balanced rules start with60% factor equities,20% IEF and20% GLD of the98% invested budget. Bonds and gold are diversifying assets, not extra equity factors.
methodology.volatility: If enabled, cap predicted total portfolio volatility at10% using trailing63-session covariance, including BIL. Scale down all non-BIL holdings together and move freed budget into BIL. Never scale up or borrow.
methodology.timing: Only completed NYSE month-end decisions, then next-open execution or one additional session under stress. Each10y/5y account starts fresh using the last known completed-month target.
methodology.data: Actual factor ETF histories from2014 onward, after every fund's inception. Reuse the original benchmark/defensive/risk-free snapshot with its unchanged hashes and dates. Different download vintages are disclosed; all compared return windows end2026-10-05.
methodology.issuer_evidence: Current issuer definitions and index labels establish the products' economic exposures, not historically unchanged methodologies or PIT constituent-level verification. Historical fund returns embed actual constituent and methodology changes.
methodology.costs: Identical USD10,000 capital,2% idle cash,USD1 commissions and5/20/50bp per-side cost scenarios. Fund-level expenses already affect prices; do not subtract current expense ratios again. Fractional units and personal-tax exclusion remain limitations.
methodology.concentration: Audit actual time-series correlations, market beta and covariance effective dimension; four funds may hold overlapping stocks and share market risk. Do not call them four independent alpha sources.
methodology.evaluation: Preserve six fixed hypotheses and all failures. Audit equity through bt, independently recompute CAGR/drawdown/Sharpe, report every available month-end rolling10y/5y base/stress window.
methodology.research_selection: Among candidates meeting all stability gates, select the smallest worst primary-path drawdown, then the highest worst-path Sharpe, then identifier. Report return-goal failures separately; this is research selection, never trading promotion.
methodology.stock_data_limit: Existing filing-date financial utilities do not establish complete historical security identities, membership and delisted prices. No claim of a direct stock-level multifactor backtest.
